```{r}
# 日本語フォント ----

)

showtext_auto()

# 優先する関数を指定 ----
conflicts_prefer(dplyr::filter)
conflicts_prefer(purrr::map)
conflicts_prefer(purrr::compact())
conflicts_prefer(quanteda::dictionary)

# ---- 設定 ----
src_var <- "source_1"
pos_var <- "stance_on_army"       # 比較に使う docvar の列名

# ---- データの読み込み ----
obj <- readRDS("prep/prep_standingarmy.rds")

df_army  <- obj$df
corp     <- obj$corp
dfm_raw  <- obj$dfm_raw
dfm_stem <- obj$dfm_stem          # 使っていなければ削除可
tok_base <- obj$tok_base          # KWIC 用
tok_pad  <- obj$tok_pad           # collocation 用（使っていなければ削除可）

# ---- 辞書の読み込み ----
dict_pol <- dictionary(file = "dictionaries/political_vocabulary.yml")
dict_rhe <- dictionary(file = "dictionaries/rhetoric.yml")
dicts    <- list(political = dict_pol, rhetoric = dict_rhe)

# ---- 関数 ----
group_key <- function(x, by = c(src_var, pos_var)) {
  dv   <- docvars(x)
  miss <- setdiff(by, names(dv))
  if (length(miss) > 0) {
    stop("docvars に列がありません: ", paste(miss, collapse = ", "),
         "\n利用できる列: ", paste(names(dv), collapse = ", "), call. = FALSE)
  }
  do.call(paste, c(as.list(dv[by]), sep = "_"))
}

split_by_group <- function(x, subset_fn, by = c(src_var, pos_var)) {
  grp <- group_key(x, by)
  map(set_names(unique(grp)), \(g) subset_fn(x, subset = grp == g))
}

run_keyness <- function(dfm_x, var, target, reference = NULL,
                        min_termfreq = 10, measure = "lr") {
  g <- docvars(dfm_x, var)
  if (!is.null(reference)) {
    dfm_x <- dfm_x[g %in% c(target, reference), ]
    g <- docvars(dfm_x, var)
  }
  dfm_x <- dfm_trim(dfm_x, min_termfreq = min_termfreq)
  textstat_keyness(dfm_x, target = g == target, measure = measure) |>
    as_tibble() |>
    mutate(p_adj = p.adjust(p, method = "BH"))
}

# ---- グループ別オブジェクト（keyness・KWIC 用）----
dfm_by  <- split_by_group(dfm_raw,  dfm_subset)     # 例: dfm_by$gm_pro_army
tok_by  <- split_by_group(tok_base, tokens_subset)  # 例: tok_by$lm_anti_army
corp_by <- split_by_group(corp,     corpus_subset)

# ---- 辞書用 tokens（ストップワードを除去しない）----
tok_dict <- tok_base |>
  tokens_compound(
    phrase(c("for this reason", "for the reason", "for these reasons", "for which reason",
             "time of peace", "times of peace")),
    concatenator = "_"
  )

# 仮名版の判定
n_pseudo <- tokens_select(tok_dict, c("lilliput*", "blefuscu*", "senate*")) |> ntoken()
docvars(tok_dict, "pseudonym") <- n_pseudo > 0

dfm_all <- dfm(tok_dict)          # pseudonym の追加の後に作る

# ---- 文書 × カテゴリの表 ----
n_tok <- tibble(
  doc_id    = docnames(tok_dict),
  n_tokens  = as.numeric(ntoken(tok_dict)),
  source    = as.character(docvars(tok_dict, src_var)),
  stance    = docvars(tok_dict, pos_var),
  pseudonym = docvars(tok_dict, "pseudonym")
)

df_long <- imap_dfr(dicts, \(d, nm) {
  convert(dfm(tokens_lookup(tok_dict, d)), to = "data.frame") |>
    as_tibble() |>
    pivot_longer(-doc_id, names_to = "category", values_to = "count") |>
    mutate(dictionary = nm)
}) |>
  left_join(n_tok, by = "doc_id") |>
  mutate(per_1000 = if_else(n_tokens > 0, count / n_tokens * 1000, NA_real_))

# table(docvars(tok_dict, "pseudonym"), docvars(tok_dict, pos_var))
```

```{r}
src_var <- "source_1"
pos_var <- "stance_on_army"

# source_1 が docvars にない場合
# docvars(tok_dict, src_var) <- df_army[[src_var]][match(docnames(tok_dict), df_army$doc_id)]

# ---- 0. 文書の内訳（まずここを確認）----
n_tok <- tibble(
  doc_id   = docnames(tok_dict),
  n_tokens = as.numeric(ntoken(tok_dict)),
  source   = docvars(tok_dict, src_var),
  stance   = docvars(tok_dict, pos_var),
  pseudonym = docvars(tok_dict, "pseudonym")
)

n_tok |>
  group_by(source, stance) |>
  summarise(n_docs = n(), n_tokens = sum(n_tokens), n_pseudonym = sum(pseudonym), .groups = "drop")

# ---- 1. 文書 × カテゴリの長い表 ----
df_long <- imap_dfr(dicts, \(d, nm) {
  convert(dfm(tokens_lookup(tok_dict, d)), to = "data.frame") |>
    as_tibble() |>
    pivot_longer(-doc_id, names_to = "category", values_to = "count") |>
    mutate(dictionary = nm)
}) |>
  left_join(select(n_tok, doc_id, n_tokens, source, stance), by = "doc_id") |>
  mutate(per_1000 = if_else(n_tokens > 0, count / n_tokens * 1000, NA_real_))

# ---- 2. gm と lm の比較（賛否はプール）----
res_src <- df_long |>
  group_by(dictionary, category) |>
  summarise(
    rate_gm   = sum(count[source == "gm"]) / sum(n_tokens[source == "gm"]) * 1000,
    rate_lm   = sum(count[source == "lm"]) / sum(n_tokens[source == "lm"]) * 1000,
    median_gm = median(per_1000[source == "gm"], na.rm = TRUE),
    median_lm = median(per_1000[source == "lm"], na.rm = TRUE),
    p_wilcox  = suppressWarnings(
      wilcox.test(per_1000[source == "gm"], per_1000[source == "lm"], exact = FALSE)$p.value),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(log2_ratio = log2(rate_gm / rate_lm),
         p_adj = p.adjust(p_wilcox, method = "holm"))

# ---- 3. 各 source の中での pro vs anti ----
res_stance <- df_long |>
  filter(stance %in% c("pro_army", "anti_army")) |>
  group_by(dictionary, category, source) |>
  summarise(
    n_pro      = n_distinct(doc_id[stance == "pro_army"]),
    n_anti     = n_distinct(doc_id[stance == "anti_army"]),
    rate_pro   = sum(count[stance == "pro_army"])  / sum(n_tokens[stance == "pro_army"])  * 1000,
    rate_anti  = sum(count[stance == "anti_army"]) / sum(n_tokens[stance == "anti_army"]) * 1000,
    median_pro  = median(per_1000[stance == "pro_army"],  na.rm = TRUE),
    median_anti = median(per_1000[stance == "anti_army"], na.rm = TRUE),
    p_wilcox   = if (n_pro >= 5 && n_anti >= 5) {
      suppressWarnings(wilcox.test(per_1000[stance == "pro_army"],
                                   per_1000[stance == "anti_army"], exact = FALSE)$p.value)
    } else NA_real_,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  group_by(source) |>
  mutate(log2_ratio = log2(rate_pro / rate_anti),
         p_adj = p.adjust(p_wilcox, method = "holm")) |>
  ungroup()

# ---- 4. 4つのセルを並べた図 ----
res_cell <- df_long |>
  filter(stance %in% c("pro_army", "anti_army")) |>
  group_by(dictionary, category, source, stance) |>
  summarise(count = sum(count), n_tokens = sum(n_tokens), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(rate = count / n_tokens * 1000)

ggplot(res_cell, aes(rate, category, fill = stance)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  facet_grid(dictionary ~ source, scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +

df_long |>

               position = position_dodge(width = 0.7), show.legend = FALSE) +
  facet_grid(dictionary ~ source, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "1000語あたりの出現数", colour = NULL)

# ---- 5. source ごとに、どの語がカテゴリを支えているか ----
dfm_src <- dfm(tok_dict) |> dfm_group(groups = docvars(tok_dict, src_var))

top_words_src <- imap_dfr(dicts, \(d, nm) {
  imap_dfr(as.list(d), \(pat, cat) {
    x <- dfm_select(dfm_src, pattern = pat, valuetype = "glob")
    if (nfeat(x) == 0) return(tibble())

  })
})

top_words_src |>

  slice_max(frequency, n = 5, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  ungroup() |>
  print(n = Inf)
```

```{r}

plot_dict <- function(dict_name, ncol = 4, drop = character(),
                      title = NULL, fig_no = NULL) {
  lv <- c("gm pro", "gm anti", "lm pro", "lm anti")

  d <- df_long |>
    filter(dictionary == dict_name,
           stance %in% c("pro_army", "anti_army"),
           !category %in% drop) |>
    mutate(
      group    = factor(paste(source, if_else(stance == "pro_army", "pro", "anti")), levels = lv),
      category = fct_reorder(category, per_1000, .fun = mean, .desc = TRUE)
    )

  # "Fig.1. ..." の形に組み立てる
  ttl <- if (is.null(title)) NULL else
    str_wrap(paste0(if (!is.null(fig_no)) paste0("Fig.", fig_no, ". "), title), width = 90)

  ggplot(d, aes(group, per_1000, colour = stance)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 2.5, linetype = "dotted", colour = "grey60") +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.12, height = 0, alpha = 0.7, size = 1.8) +
    stat_summary(fun = median, geom = "point", shape = 18, size = 4, colour = "black") +
    facet_wrap(~ category, scales = "free_y", ncol = ncol,
               labeller = label_wrap_gen(22)) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c(pro_army = "#d95f02", anti_army = "#1b9e77")) +
    labs(
      title  = ttl,
      x      = NULL,
      y      = "normalized frequency (per 1,000 words)",
      colour = NULL
    ) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0),
          plot.title.position = "plot")   # タイトルをパネルでなく図全体の左端に揃える
}


p_pol <- plot_dict("political", ncol = 3, fig_no = 4,
                   title = "Political Vocabulary in GM and LM Speeches for and against Standing Armies")

p_rhe <- plot_dict("rhetoric", ncol = 4, fig_no = 5,
                   title = "Rhetorical Vocabulary in GM and LM Speeches for and against Standing Armies")

# 保存
ggsave("img/fig_arimty_political.svg", p_pol,
       device = "svg", width = 300, height = 170, units = "mm")

ggsave("img/fig_arimty_rhetoric.svg", p_rhe,
       device = "svg", width = 230, height = 100, units = "mm")
```

```{r}
# 図と同じ条件で、群 × カテゴリの要約表を作る
summarise_dict <- function(dict_name, drop = character()) {
  df_long |>
    filter(dictionary == dict_name,
           stance %in% c("pro_army", "anti_army"),
           !category %in% drop) |>
    mutate(group = factor(paste(source, if_else(stance == "pro_army", "pro", "anti")),
                          levels = c("gm pro", "gm anti", "lm pro", "lm anti"))) |>
    group_by(category, group) |>
    summarise(
      n_docs = n(),
      n_zero = sum(count == 0),                       # 0件の文書数
      median = median(per_1000, na.rm = TRUE),
      mean   = mean(per_1000, na.rm = TRUE),
      min    = min(per_1000, na.rm = TRUE),
      max    = max(per_1000, na.rm = TRUE),
      pooled = sum(count) / sum(n_tokens) * 1000,     # 群全体の1000語あたり
      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    mutate(across(c(median, mean, min, max, pooled), \(x) round(x, 2)))
}

tab_pol <- summarise_dict("political")
tab_rhe <- summarise_dict("rhetoric", drop = "rhetorical_expression")

# コンソールに全行・全列を表示
tab_pol |> print(n = Inf, width = Inf)
tab_rhe |> print(n = Inf, width = Inf)
```

## keyness

### GM

```{r}

key_gm <-
  dfm_raw |>
  dfm_subset(source_1 == "gm") |>
  run_keyness("stance_on_army", "pro_army", "anti_army")

key_plot <-
  key_gm |>
  mutate(group = if_else(G2 > 0, "pro_army", "anti_army")) |>
  group_by(group) |>
  slice_max(abs(G2), n = 15) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(
    score = abs(G2),
    group = factor(
      group,
      levels = c("pro_army", "anti_army"),
      labels = c("Defended standing armies", "Supported the reduction")
    )
  )

p1 <-
  key_plot |>
  ggplot(aes(x = score, y = reorder_within(feature, score, group))) +
  geom_col(color = "black", linewidth = 0.3) +
  scale_y_reordered() +
  facet_wrap(~ group, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(
    title = "Fig.1. Key Terms in GM Speeches for and against Standing Armies",
    x = "Log-likelihood ratio (G2)",
    y = NULL
  )

ggsave(
  "img/keyness_compare_gm_standingarmy.svg",
  device = "svg",
  plot = p1,
  # width = 90, #2段組
  # height = 60,
  width = 170, #1段組
  height = 90,
  units = "mm",
  dpi = 600
)


```

```{r}
df_army |> count(source_1, stance_on_army)

# 文書頻度（上位語が何文書に出ているか）
d   <- dfm_trim(dfm_raw, min_termfreq = 10)
tgt <- docvars(d, "stance_on_army") == "pro_army"
disp <- tibble(
  feature = featnames(d),
  df_pro  = as.numeric(docfreq(d[tgt, ])),
  df_anti = as.numeric(docfreq(d[!tgt, ]))
)
key |> left_join(disp, by = "feature") |> filter(p_adj < 0.4)   # key は今回の結果

# 雑誌ごとに分けて、同じ語が出るか
key_by_source <- map(set_names(c("gm", "lm")), \(s)
  dfm_raw |> dfm_subset(source_1 == s) |>
    run_keyness("stance_on_army", "pro_army", "anti_army"))

  slice_sample(n = 8, by = c(pattern, stance_on_army))
```

# 辞書分析

## 辞書の調整

```{r}

# どの語がカテゴリを押し上げているかの確認

dfm_all <- dfm(tok_dict)

top_words <- imap_dfr(dicts, \(d, nm) {
  imap_dfr(as.list(d), \(pat, cat) {
    x <- dfm_select(dfm_all, pattern = pat, valuetype = "glob")
    if (nfeat(x) == 0) return(tibble())
    textstat_frequency(x) |>
      as_tibble() |>
      transmute(dictionary = nm, category = cat, feature, frequency, docfreq)
  })
})

top_words |>
  group_by(dictionary, category) |>
  mutate(share = frequency / sum(frequency)) |>
  slice_max(frequency, n = 5, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  ungroup() |>
  print(n = 100)

```


```{r}

set.seed(1)

kwic(tok_base,
     c("court", "emperor*", "good", "fame", "reputation*",
       "interest", "establishment", "right*", "just"),
     window = 5) |>
  as_tibble() |>
  group_by(pattern) |>
  slice_sample(n = 15) |>
  ungroup() |>
  select(pattern, pre, keyword, post) |>
  print(n = Inf)

nrow(kwic(tok_base, phrase(c("time of peace", "times of peace"))))

```
